svg.title: 07-thermal-closure-method
svg.desc: Actual input-basis coordinates replace every schematic atom. The24-atom reference has one selected center cell. The representative longer construction repeats the same verified input cell19times, selecting17center cells with one buffer at eachend;152atoms, selected length9.237052051nm, constructed full length10.323764057nm. This geometry illustrates the Thermal closure method construction, not an independently retrieved coordinate export from a specific long run. Temperature nodes are model parameters, not atom positions or measured thermalization.
